title: Trickery TDM League Season 1
wikitext:
[[Image:Trickery.gif|centre|Trickery Logo]]
[[Trickery TDM League Season 1]] (TTDML) was a [[4on4]] [[Team Deathmatch]] tournament from Great Britain. Mainly classic British custom maps were the ones to be played in the tournament, both division one and two had four clans this season.

* website: [http://www.daddied.com/ttdml/ www.daddied.com]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/ttdml #ttdml] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Maps: [[e2m7]], [[punish]], [[ukpak2]], [[ukcldm2]], [[ukcldm6]] and in the 4v4v4v4 final [[qffldm2]]
* Date: Played between 26-01-2004 and 08-03-2004
